description: Main FastAPI application source file for the Notes Manager backend. Defines API endpoints for user registration, authentication, and CRUD operations for notes, including markdown rendering.

methods.name: User get_current_user(token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Dependency to retrieve the current authenticated user based on JWT token.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint returning a simple message.

methods.name: register(user: UserCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user with a unique username and email.

methods.name: login(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint for user login which returns a JWT access token upon successful authentication.

methods.name: create_note(note: NoteCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Create and save a new note for the authenticated user.

methods.name: list_notes(db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieve all notes belonging to the current user.

methods.name: get_note(note_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieve a specific note by ID, ensuring it belongs to the current user.

methods.name: update_note(note_id: int, note: NoteUpdate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Update an existing note's title or content if it belongs to the current user.

methods.name: delete_note(note_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Delete a note, only if it belongs to the current user.

methods.name: render_note_markdown(note_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Render the markdown content of a note as HTML for preview purposes.
